deadline.value: The FAQ gives a July 15 date only for spring admission; no Fall date is on a fetched page.
deadline.quote: all application materials must be received before the July 15 deadline for international students

gre_subject.value: The GRE is not required, so no Chemistry subject test is needed.

toefl_min.value: The FAQ gives an old-scale TOEFL iBT 80, which is not recorded; the Graduate School's 4.0 new-scale rule applies.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo scores for international students are 80, 6.5 and 105, respectively.

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly advised to contact potential research advisors, but it is not required.
supervisor.quote: It is strongly recommended that you contact potential research advisors to ensure availability and compatible research interests, but it is not required.

funding.value: All graduate students are supported by a teaching or research assistantship for their studies.
funding.quote: All graduate students are supported by either a teaching or research assistantship for the duration of their studies.

entry_route.value: Holders of a B.S. in Chemistry, Biochemistry or a related degree may apply for the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Students holding B.S. in Chemistry, Biochemistry or related degree are eligible to apply for either M.S. or Ph.D. degrees.

notes: Department FAQ (copyright 2024 on the page). The official admissions sub-page returned 404, so no Fall deadline was verified.
name: Chemistry (Ph.D.)
